item.title: Collisions Fall After Wildlife Overpass: I-25 crossings cut crashes by up to 91%; Colorado plans six more
item.description: A network of wildlife crossings in Colorado has reduced collisions along Interstate 25 by approximately 85 percent. This system includes fencing, underpasses, and an overpass which opened in December 2025. Recent studies show a significant decline in wildlife-related crashes since the introduction of these measures. Various species, including elk and pronghorn, have begun using these crossings effectively. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: After 2005 rat removal, three seabird species on a Pacific island grew up to tenfold over decades
item.description: The successful eradication of invasive rodents in 2005 has greatly influenced seabird populations on Surprise Island. Researchers closely monitored seven seabird species to document their recovery post-eradication. While some species thrived quickly, others needed more extended observation to show signs of improvement. Notably, noddies saw a significant increase in breeding pairs, whereas red-footed boobies showed a more gradual recovery. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: At least 16 people were killed and 32 more injured when a strong 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck China’s western Tibet autonomous region late on Thursday, state news agency Xinhua said, citing local authorities. More than 300 houses collapsed in the earthquake, which struck on Thursday at 10.33pm. Officials were still evaluating the damage, and disaster relief work was ongoing, Xinhua said. item.description: In 2018, Vanessa Hudgens acquired a charming historic residence in Los Angeles from Gary Oldman for almost $5 million. She renovated and redesigned the space, ultimately selling it to Ronan Farrow and Jon Lovett in February 2022 for an impressive $6.725 million. The 1922-built house, fondly known as Little DeMille, boasted rich heritage, beautiful gardens, and artistic enhancements by Hudgens, showcasing her flair for style. item.description: The iconic Ellis Building, erected in 1922, is set to undergo a transformation into a chic boutique hotel, managed by Aperture Hotels and affiliated with Marriott's Tribute Portfolio. This revitalization aims to breathe new life into the historic space, following previous redevelopment failures. The project promises about 95 to 105 stylish guest rooms, complemented by a modern restaurant and bar, aligning with similar projects in downtown Phoenix. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Scientists turn art detectives to date van Gogh's 'Starry Night' to actual sky from 1889
item.description: A team of South Korean researchers has put forward a new date for the night sky depicted in Dutch painter Vincent van Gogh's famed masterpiece "The Starry Night". Art historians have long assumed the stars were a product of the artist's fantasy or dated the scene to June 1889 based on the artist's known location and other factors, but astronomical details like the sliver crescent moon didn't line up. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Olivia Wilde sells Studio City home for nearly $1m less than asking
item.description: Olivia Wilde recently offloaded her Studio City residence for $5.23 million, a price tag that fell short of her original purchase. Designed by architect Barbara Bestor, the home boasted a sleek modern-ranch aesthetic. Initially on the market for $6.2 million, the sale concluded in December, adding to her previous real estate transaction in Silver Lake, sold at $4.2 million. item.title: Amazon loses 240 million acres of forest, risking rainfall disruption
item.description: According to a recent report, the Amazon has lost 97 million hectares of primary forest by 2025. Most forest loss is attributed to human activity, particularly land clearing and fires. The disruptions to moisture pathways during dry seasons raise critical concerns for the ecosystem. A strong El Niño expected in late 2026 could exacerbate these issues and increase fire risks. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: In North Dakota, a retired farmer is turning erosion-susceptible farmland into lush grassland to secure annual earnings. item.title: A SpaceX no le gusta que China le pise los talones, así que va a hacer lo que nadie ha hecho: recuperar y reutilizar las dos etapas de un cohete
item.description: Parece que a Elon Musk no le gusta sentir que alguien le pisa los talones. Hace tiempo que la compañía china Deep Blue Aerospace publicó su interés en recuperar un cohete mediante un sistema de torre con palillos, como Mechazilla. Ahora, además, ha anunciado que las primeras piezas del cohete están saliendo de la cadena de montaje y que todo va viento en popa. Ha sido el momento ideal para que SpaceX anuncie que intentará algo aún más difícil que lo que ya hizo en Mechazilla: recuperar las dos etapas de su cohete Starship mediante ese sistema. item.description: Garrett Brown launched Cameron Ranch Glamping on a picturesque 10-acre plot in Houston, beginning with a minimal budget. The business flourished initially with a geodome, later evolving through zero-cost revenue-sharing arrangements. item.description: Indonesia afronta una de sus peores crisis de incendios forestales en más de una década. La emergencia coincide con protestas contra la gestión del Gobierno y una investigación por presunta corrupción en la contratación de fondos de emergencia. ¿Qué está detrás de los incendios y qué puede hacer Yakarta para frenar una crisis que afecta a toda la región?
